text: Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed cushions on Berry Road between Prince Edward Drive South and Park Lawn Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed cushions are warranted to be installed on Berry Road.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (4 speed cushions) on Berry Road, between Prince Edward Drive South and Park Lawn Road, generally as shown in Attachment 2, Drawing No. TC-734 and TC734-1, to the report (June 18, 2026) from the Acting Deputy General Manager, Transportation Services. 2. Subject to approval of Part 1 above, reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Berry Road between Prince Edward Drive South and Park Lawn Road, in conjunction with the installation of speed cushions.
